comment: Developer tool for the nightly benchmark: plain http only to a fixed address, the Ollama daemon on 127.0.0.1:11434 (the OLLAMA constant), never anything a user supplies. The models it names end in :cloud, so Ollama relays the prompts, which carry the nightly's findings and code excerpts from the scanned benchmark apps, to Ollama Cloud over its own https connection.
